en.description: A dual agonist of the GIP and GLP-1 receptors. It is described in the context of satiety pathways, glucose-dependent insulin response and energy metabolism.
en.subtitle: Dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist
en.intro: Tirzepatide is a dual agonist of the GIP and GLP-1 receptors, two incretins involved in the regulation of blood glucose levels and appetite. It acts on satiety, the glucose-dependent insulin response and energy metabolism.
en.purityNote: Purity (HPLC) measures the absence of relevant impurities; it is distinct from the net peptide content, as salts and counter-ions (acetate, TFA) contribute to the total mass of the vial. This must be taken into account when calculating the actual concentration upon reconstitution.

chemistry.label: Sequence
chemistry.value: Modified 39-mer (2× Aib, acylated Lys20 C20 diacid; C-terminal amide)

highlights.title: Reduced appetite
highlights.text: Works on the body’s central satiety signals to naturally reduce hunger.

highlights.title: Stabilised blood glucose levels
highlights.text: Improves glucose-dependent insulin secretion and insulin sensitivity.

highlights.title: Prolonged feeling of fullness
highlights.text: Slows down gastric emptying, prolonging the feeling of fullness.

highlights.title: Body composition
highlights.text: Helps reduce body fat as part of a calorie deficit.

mechanism.text: GLP-1: activation of POMC/CART neurons (satiety), inhibition of NPY/AgRP (hunger), and slowing of gastric emptying.
GIP: enhancement of the glucose-dependent insulin response and modulation of lipid metabolism.
The dual activation of GIP and GLP-1 creates a synergistic effect on glycaemic control and appetite that is greater than that of a GLP-1 agonist alone.
Long half-life (~5 days) → gradual accumulation; steady state is reached after ~4 weeks at a stable dose.
Glucose-dependent insulin secretion: its action is modulated according to blood glucose levels, thereby limiting the risk of hypoglycaemia when used as monotherapy.

history.title: Start of Phase 3 trials
history.text: The SURPASS (diabetes) and SURMOUNT (obesity) programmes are getting underway, evaluating tirzepatide over 72 weeks.

history.title: FDA approval (diabetes)
history.text: On 13 May 2022, the FDA approved tirzepatide, marketed as Mounjaro, for type 2 diabetes.

history.title: SURMOUNT-1 results
history.text: The SURMOUNT-1 obesity trial showed weight loss of up to approximately 21 per cent at the 15 mg dose over 72 weeks.

history.title: FDA approval (obesity)
history.text: On 8 November 2023, the FDA approved the same active ingredient, marketed as Zepbound, for weight management.

history.title: Extension of indications
history.text: New indications have been approved, including obesity-related obstructive sleep apnoea.

handling.text: Progress slowly: allow for a period of around 4 weeks before increasing the intensity.
Inject on the same day each week to maintain stable levels.
Optimal hydration and electrolyte intake (sodium, potassium, magnesium).
Eat smaller, more frequent meals: 4 to 6 small meals to help reduce nausea.
Prioritise an adequate intake of protein (1.6 to 2.2 g/kg) to maintain lean body mass.
Keep a diary: symptoms, meals, fluid intake, weight, sleep.

storage.label: Before reconstitution (freeze-dried powder)
storage.text: in the fridge (2–8 °C), away from light; can be kept at room temperature for short periods during transport.

storage.label: After reconstruction
storage.text: in the fridge (2–8 °C); should generally be used within ~4 weeks (28 days).

storage.label: Note
storage.text: Do not freeze, do not shake vigorously, and keep away from heat and direct light.

safety.text: Pregnancy and breastfeeding: avoid.
Personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2 (MEN 2): contraindication.
History of pancreatitis; gallbladder disease; gastroparesis or severe digestive disorder: use with caution.

Interactions: risk of hypoglycaemia when taken with insulin or sulphonylureas; delayed gastric emptying may reduce the effectiveness of oral contraceptives and alter the absorption of other medicines.
Known hypersensitivity to tirzepatide or to any of the excipients.

timeline.text: Initial dose (2.5 mg): reduced appetite; possible initial digestive side effects.
Increase in dosage: greater feeling of fullness, more stable energy levels, and the onset of fat loss.
Progress: more consistent weight loss, better control of portion sizes and cravings.

synergies.text: Sodium, potassium and magnesium — help prevent tiredness, cramps and headaches.
Help maintain lean body mass during a calorie deficit.

sideEffects.text: Nausea (the most common side effect, particularly at the start of treatment or following a dose increase).
Diarrhoea or constipation, bloating, feeling full quickly, belching.
Headaches, temporary tiredness, a significant loss of appetite.
Most digestive side effects subside within a few days or weeks as the body adjusts.

Things to watch out for (seek medical advice if severe or persistent): repeated vomiting, severe abdominal pain, signs of pancreatitis, severe hypoglycaemia (particularly when used in combination with other treatments).

dosage.timing: A fixed day each week (in the evening for tolerance)
dosage.halfLife: ~5 days (~120 hours) — suitable for a single weekly injection

notes.text: We stay at the same level and let the natural build-up take its course. Progress slowly.

relatedSections.title: Accumulation logic
relatedSections.text: Tirzepatide has a long half-life (~5 days). The overall effect develops gradually over several weeks at a constant dose. It is essential to increase the dose in stages, to allow the body to adapt, and to avoid rapid increases, which exacerbate gastrointestinal side effects.

relatedSections.title: Signs to look out for
relatedSections.text:
- Positive effects: natural feeling of fullness, steady energy levels, healthy digestion, gradual weight loss.
- Areas for adjustment: severe tiredness, dizziness/headaches, muscle cramps, persistent nausea, complete loss of appetite.

relatedSections.title: Golden Rule
relatedSections.text: Consistency in daily life takes precedence over occasional bursts of intensity. We make adjustments based on data (weight, waist circumference, hunger, energy levels) rather than emotions.

relatedSections.title: Suggested adjustment scale (for guidance only)
relatedSections.text:
- Insufficient weight loss / plateau → increase to the next dose level (usually +2.5 mg) after ~4 weeks of tolerance.
- Weight loss too rapid (> 1 per cent per week) → maintain the current dose or increase calorie intake.
- Troublesome side effects → remain at the current level for longer, or even go back one level.

products.name: BPC-157
products.description: Peptide présenté comme étudié dans le contexte de la réparation et de la protection des tissus. Les domaines cités comprennent les tissus conjonctifs, la muqueuse digestive et la cicatrisation.
products.subtitle: Body Protection Compound-157
products.intro: Le BPC-157 est l'un des peptides les plus puissants pour la réparation, la protection et la régénération des tissus. Polyvalent et très bien toléré, il agit sur de nombreux systèmes pour des résultats rapides et durables...
products.purityNote: La pureté (HPLC) mesure l'absence d'impuretés apparentées ; elle est distincte de la teneur nette en peptide, car les sels et contre-ions (acétate, TFA) comptent dans la masse du flacon. À prendre en compte pour la concentration réelle à la reconstitution.

highlights.title: Répare les tissus
highlights.text: Accélère la guérison des tendons, ligaments et muscles.

highlights.title: Anti-inflammatoire
highlights.text: Réduit l'inflammation et la douleur.

highlights.title: Régénération & cicatrisation
highlights.text: Favorise la régénération des tissus et la cicatrisation.

highlights.title: Protection gastrique
highlights.text: Protège et guérit la muqueuse gastrique et intestinale.

highlights.title: Mobilité articulaire
highlights.text: Améliore la mobilité et la flexibilité articulaire.

highlights.title: Récupération post-opératoire
highlights.text: Soutient la récupération et la prévention des blessures.

mechanism.text: Angiogenèse : stimule la formation de nouveaux vaisseaux sanguins pour une meilleure vascularisation des tissus.
Cytoprotection : protège les cellules des dommages oxydatifs, chimiques et des blessures mécaniques.
Régénération tissulaire : accélère la réparation des tendons, ligaments, muscles, os, peau et muqueuses.
Anti-inflammatoire : réduit l'inflammation en modulant les cytokines et l'activité du facteur NF-kB.
Neuroprotection : soutient la régénération nerveuse et protège les neurones.

history.title: Première description scientifique
history.text: L'équipe de Predrag Sikirić (Université de Zagreb) isole et décrit le pentadécapeptide BPC-157, fragment d'une protéine protectrice du suc gastrique.

history.title: Extension à la réparation tissulaire
history.text: Les travaux précliniques élargissent l'intérêt du BPC-157 des ulcères digestifs à la cicatrisation des tendons, muscles, os et au système nerveux.

history.title: Diffusion et statut investigational
history.text: Le peptide gagne en notoriété dans la recherche et l'usage sportif tout en restant un composé non approuvé, sans essai clinique humain publié de grande ampleur.

history.title: Classement FDA catégorie 2
history.text: La FDA place le BPC-157 en catégorie 2 des substances en vrac (section 503A), le jugeant à risque et non éligible à la préparation magistrale.

history.title: Retrait de la catégorie 2
history.text: En avril 2026 la FDA retire le BPC-157 de la liste catégorie 2 sans l'approuver, un comité consultatif devant réexaminer son cas en juillet 2026.

La régénération tissulaire est décrite comme un processus progressif exigeant régularité et durée.
Prudence particulière décrite en cas de grossesse, d'allaitement ou de condition médicale préexistante.

stacks.title: Récupération & réparation tissulaire
stacks.text:
Le duo de référence pour la réparation des tissus mous : action locale rapide du BPC-157 et action systémique prolongée du TB-500.
BPC-157 Réparation locale, tendons/ligaments, confort digestif TB-500 Récupération systémique, souplesse, régénération
Pourquoi ça marche BPC-157 et TB-500 agissent par des voies complémentaires (angiogenèse locale vs migration cellulaire systémique) — l'association est la plus citée pour accélérer la récupération après blessure ou surmenage.

Commencer par les doses basses de chaque peptide et évaluer la tolérance.

Non hormonal et non dopant.

extraSections.title: Qu'est-ce que le BPC-157 ?
extraSections.text:
Le BPC-157 est un peptide stable composé de 15 acides aminés, naturellement présent dans le suc gastrique humain et impliqué dans les processus de guérison et de protection des tissus.
- Nom : Body Protection Compound 157
- Séquence : GEPPPGKPADDAGLV (15 acides aminés)
- Origine : suc (succus) gastrique humain
- Poids moléculaire : 1419,47 Da
- Forme : lyophilisée, excellente solubilité dans l'eau

extraSections.title: Domaines et cibles d'action
extraSections.text:
Le BPC-157 agit là où le corps a besoin de réparation.
- Système musculo-squelettique : tendons, ligaments, muscles, os et cartilages (épaules, coudes, poignets, genoux, chevilles).
- Système digestif : protection et guérison de la muqueuse gastrique et intestinale.
- Système nerveux : régénération des nerfs périphériques et neuroprotection.
- Peau & tissus conjonctifs : cicatrisation des plaies, brûlures et lésions cutanées.
- Système cardiovasculaire : protection des vaisseaux et amélioration de la circulation.
- Récupération globale : réduit le temps de récupération et améliore la résilience.

extraSections.title: Optimisation des résultats
extraSections.text:
- Nutrition anti-inflammatoire riche en antioxydants, oméga-3 et protéines de qualité.
- Hydratation optimale (au moins 2 – 3 L/jour) pour soutenir les processus de guérison.
- Sommeil profond et repos, essentiels à la régénération tissulaire.
- Gestion du stress : le stress chronique peut ralentir la récupération.
- Mobilité & rééducation adaptées à la lésion ; limiter alcool, tabac et sucres.

mechanism.text: Angiogenesis: stimulates the formation of new blood vessels to improve tissue perfusion.

history.text: Preclinical studies are broadening the scope of BPC-157’s applications from digestive ulcers to the healing of tendons, muscles, bones and the nervous system.

history.title: Distribution and investigational status
history.text: The peptide is gaining recognition in research and in the world of sport, whilst remaining an unapproved compound with no published large-scale human clinical trials.

history.title: FDA Class 2 classification
history.text: The FDA classifies BPC-157 as a Category 2 bulk substance (Section 503A), deeming it to pose a risk and ineligible for compounding.

history.title: Withdrawal from Category 2
history.text: In April 2026, the FDA removed BPC-157 from the Category 2 list without approving it; an advisory committee is due to review its case in July 2026.

handling.text: The protocols describe starting treatment at the lowest effective dose, which is then adjusted according to the individual’s response.
The protocols describe alternating injection sites to minimise local irritation.
The literature links an anti-inflammatory diet, good hydration (2–3 litres of water per day) and good-quality sleep to better outcomes.
Tissue regeneration is described as a gradual process that requires consistency and time.
Special precautions are outlined in the event of pregnancy, breastfeeding or a pre-existing medical condition.

stacks.title: Tissue recovery & repair
stacks.text:
The go-to combination for soft tissue repair: the rapid local action of BPC-157 and the prolonged systemic action of TB-500.
BPC-157 Local repair, tendons/ligaments, digestive comfort TB-500 Systemic recovery, flexibility, regeneration
Why it works: BPC-157 and TB-500 act via complementary mechanisms (local angiogenesis vs systemic cell migration) — this combination is the most widely cited for accelerating recovery following injury or overexertion.
Research findings: no clinically validated dosage in humans.
Start with low doses of each peptide and assess tolerance.

extraSections.title: What is BPC-157?
extraSections.text:
BPC-157 is a stable peptide comprising 15 amino acids, which occurs naturally in human gastric juice and is involved in tissue healing and protection.
- Name: Body Protection Compound 157
- Sequence: GEPPPGKPADDAGLV (15 amino acids)
- Origin: human gastric juice (succus)
- Molecular weight: 1419.47 Da
- Form: freeze-dried, excellent solubility in water

extraSections.title: Areas and targets for action
extraSections.text:
BPC-157 acts wherever the body needs repair.
- Musculoskeletal system: tendons, ligaments, muscles, bones and cartilage (shoulders, elbows, wrists, knees, ankles).
- Digestive system: protection and healing of the gastric and intestinal mucosa.
- Nervous system: regeneration of peripheral nerves and neuroprotection.
- Skin and connective tissues: healing of wounds, burns and skin lesions.
- Cardiovascular system: protection of blood vessels and improved circulation.
- Overall recovery: reduces recovery time and improves resilience.

extraSections.title: Optimising results
extraSections.text:
- An anti-inflammatory diet rich in antioxidants, omega-3 and high-quality protein.
- Optimal hydration (at least 2–3 litres per day) to support the healing process.
- Deep sleep and rest, which are essential for tissue regeneration.
- Stress management: chronic stress can slow down recovery.
- Mobility exercises and rehabilitation tailored to the injury; limit alcohol, tobacco and sugar.

dosage.timing: 1 to 2 injections a day, depending on the objective; maintenance: 2 to 5 injections a week
dosage.halfLife: Short plasma half-life (ranging from a few minutes to less than ~30 minutes in animals), but prolonged tissue effects extending beyond clearance.

- Digestive models: protocols over 4 to 12 weeks, often under fasting conditions as reported in the literature.

products.name: BPC-157 / TB-500 Blend
products.description: Mélange réunissant BPC-157 et TB-500. Il est présenté autour de la réparation tissulaire, de la migration cellulaire et de la récupération.
products.subtitle: Blend réparation & récupération (BPC-157 + fragment de Thymosine Bêta-4)
products.intro: Ce blend associe dans un même flacon le BPC-157 et le TB-500 (fragment synthétique de la Thymosine Bêta-4), deux des peptides de récupération les plus étudiés, réputés complémentaires. Le BPC-157 cible la protection et la réparation localisée des tissus (tendons, ligaments, muqueuse digestive), tandis que le TB-500 favorise la migration cellulaire et une régénération plus systémique. Ensemble, ils sont recherchés pour accélérer la récupération après blessure et soutenir la réparation des tissus. Le flacon de 20 mg contient un mélange 1:1 (soit environ 10 mg de chaque peptide).

highlights.text: Combine la réparation localisée du BPC-157 et la régénération systémique du TB-500.

highlights.title: Récupération accélérée

highlights.title: Anti-inflammatoire

highlights.title: Mobilité

highlights.title: Praticité

mechanism.text: BPC-157 : cytoprotection et réparation tissulaire localisée, soutien de la muqueuse digestive et de la régénération des tendons/ligaments.
TB-500 : favorise la migration des cellules réparatrices (fibroblastes, cellules endothéliales) vers les zones lésées.
Angiogenèse : les deux peptides soutiennent la formation de nouveaux vaisseaux et une meilleure vascularisation des tissus.
Modulation de l'inflammation : réduction des signaux inflammatoires pour accélérer la résolution.
Action complémentaire : réparation « ciblée » (BPC-157) et régénération « globale » (TB-500) dans une même administration.

Les deux peptides agissent sur des voies complémentaires de la réparation. Les combiner dans un même flacon simplifie le protocole tout en couvrant à la fois la réparation localisée et la régénération systémique.

- Idéal pour les blessures sévères, la récupération post-effort et le post-opératoire.

en.description: A blend combining BPC-157 and TB-500. It is marketed for tissue repair, cell migration and recovery.
en.subtitle: Repair & Recovery Blend (BPC-157 + Thymosin Beta-4 fragment)
en.intro: This blend combines BPC-157 and TB-500 (a synthetic fragment of Thymosin Beta-4) – two of the most extensively studied recovery peptides, which are known to be complementary – in a single vial. BPC-157 targets the protection and localised repair of tissues (tendons, ligaments, digestive mucosa), whilst TB-500 promotes cell migration and more systemic regeneration. Together, they are sought after for their ability to accelerate recovery following injury and support tissue repair. The 20 mg vial contains a 1:1 mixture (i.e. approximately 10 mg of each peptide).

highlights.title: Repair synergy
highlights.text: Combines the localised repair effects of BPC-157 with the systemic regenerative effects of TB-500.

highlights.title: Accelerated recovery
highlights.text: Supports faster recovery following injury, intense exercise or surgery.

highlights.title: Anti-inflammatory
highlights.text: Helps to reduce inflammation and discomfort associated with tissue damage.

highlights.title: Tendons & ligaments
highlights.text: It specifically targets the health of tendons, ligaments and joints.

highlights.title: Mobility
highlights.text: May improve mobility and flexibility as the course of treatment progresses.

highlights.title: Practicality
highlights.text: One vial, one injection for two complementary peptides.

mechanism.text: BPC-157: cytoprotection and localised tissue repair, support for the digestive mucosa and the regeneration of tendons and ligaments.
TB-500: promotes the migration of repair cells (fibroblasts, endothelial cells) to damaged areas.
Angiogenesis: both peptides support the formation of new blood vessels and improved tissue vascularisation.
Modulation of inflammation: reducing inflammatory signals to speed up resolution.
Complementary action: ‘targeted’ repair (BPC-157) and ‘comprehensive’ regeneration (TB-500) in a single administration.

The two peptides act on complementary repair pathways. Combining them in a single vial simplifies the protocol whilst addressing both localised repair and systemic regeneration.
- BPC-157: targeted repair (tendons, ligaments, intestine), cellular protection.
- TB-500: cell migration and broader tissue regeneration.
- Ideal for severe injuries, post-exercise recovery and post-operative care.

products.name: CJC-1295 (sans DAC)
products.description: Analogue de la GHRH également appelé Mod GRF (1-29). Il est décrit dans le cadre de recherches sur la sécrétion pulsatile de l’hormone de croissance.
products.subtitle: Analogue de la GHRH — Mod GRF (1-29)
products.intro: Le CJC-1295 sans DAC, aussi appelé Mod GRF (1-29), est un analogue court de la GHRH (hormone de libération de l'hormone de croissance). Il stimule l'hypophyse pour induire un pic (pulse) naturel de sécrétion de GH, suivi d'une hausse d'IGF-1, tout en respectant la pulsatilité physiologique. Sa courte demi-vie le rend particulièrement adapté à une association avec un GHRP comme l'Ipamorelin, dont l'action est complémentaire.
products.purityNote: La pureté (HPLC) mesure l'absence d'impuretés apparentées ; elle est distincte de la teneur nette en peptide, car les sels et contre-ions (acétate, TFA) comptent dans la masse du flacon. À prendre en compte pour la concentration réelle à la reconstitution.

highlights.title: Pulse de GH
highlights.text: Favorise une libération pulsatile et physiologique d'hormone de croissance par l'hypophyse.

highlights.title: Synergie GHRP
highlights.text: S'associe naturellement à un GHRP (ex. Ipamorelin) pour une réponse GH amplifiée.

highlights.title: Récupération
highlights.text: Soutient la réparation des tissus et la récupération après l'effort.

highlights.title: Sommeil
highlights.text: Peut contribuer à un sommeil plus profond, phase clé de la sécrétion de GH.

highlights.title: Composition corporelle
highlights.text: Aide, via la hausse d'IGF-1, à préserver la masse maigre et à mobiliser les graisses.

highlights.title: Pulsatilité respectée
highlights.text: Sa courte durée d'action limite la saturation des récepteurs et préserve le rythme naturel de GH.

mechanism.text: Se lie aux récepteurs de la GHRH sur l'hypophyse pour déclencher un pulse de sécrétion d'hormone de croissance.
Entraîne une élévation secondaire de l'IGF-1, médiateur de la régénération et de la synthèse protéique.
Agit sur une voie distincte mais complémentaire de celle des GHRP (récepteur de la ghréline), d'où une forte synergie avec l'Ipamorelin.
Sa forme « sans DAC » (Mod GRF 1-29) a une demi-vie courte, produisant un pic bref proche de la libération physiologique naturelle.
Le respect de la pulsatilité limite la désensibilisation et favorise un profil hormonal proche du fonctionnement normal.

history.title: Développement chez ConjuChem
history.text: La société montréalaise ConjuChem conçoit CJC-1295 à partir d'un GHRH (1-29) tétra-substitué stabilisé, couplé à sa technologie DAC de liaison à l'albumine.

history.title: Analogue à action prolongée
history.text: La version avec DAC prolonge fortement la demi-vie, tandis que la forme sans DAC (Mod GRF 1-29) reste de courte durée d'action.

history.title: Essai clinique de phase 1/2
history.text: Teichman et ses collègues rapportent dans le JCEM une élévation prolongée de la GH et de l'IGF-1 chez des adultes sains après dose unique.

history.title: Jamais approuvé
history.text: Le développement clinique n'a pas abouti et CJC-1295 n'a reçu aucune approbation réglementaire, restant un peptide de recherche.

handling.text: Injecter à jeun : un pic d'insuline ou de glucides atténue la réponse en GH.
Associer à un GHRP comme l'Ipamorelin pour maximiser le pulse de GH.
Privilégier une prise avant le coucher pour s'aligner sur le pic de GH nocturne.
Attendre 20-30 minutes avant de manger après l'injection.
Commencer bas, aller lentement, et maintenir une bonne hygiène de sommeil.

extraSections.title: Ce qu'il n'est pas
extraSections.text:
- Ce n'est pas un stéroïde.
- Ce n'est pas de la GH exogène : il stimule la production endogène.
- Ce n'est pas un brûleur de graisse direct.
- Ce n'est pas un produit miracle : il est décrit comme amplifiant les efforts, sans les remplacer.

extraSections.title: Sans DAC vs avec DAC
extraSections.text:
- La version « sans DAC » (Mod GRF 1-29) a une demi-vie courte et génère un pic bref, proche du rythme naturel.
- La version « avec DAC » a une demi-vie longue et maintient un taux de GH élevé sur plusieurs jours.

en.description: A GHRH analogue, also known as Mod GRF (1-29). It is described in the context of research into the pulsatile secretion of growth hormone.
en.subtitle: GHRH analogue — Mod GRF (1-29)
en.intro: CJC-1295 without DAC, also known as Mod GRF (1-29), is a short analogue of GHRH (growth hormone-releasing hormone). It stimulates the pituitary gland to induce a natural pulse of GH secretion, followed by a rise in IGF-1, whilst maintaining physiological pulsatility. Its short half-life makes it particularly suitable for use in combination with a GHRP such as Ipamorelin, which has a complementary action.

mechanism.text: Binds to GHRH receptors on the pituitary gland to trigger a surge in growth hormone secretion.

history.text: The Montreal-based company ConjuChem is developing CJC-1295 from a stabilised, tetra-substituted GHRH (1-29), coupled with its DAC technology for binding to albumin.

extraSections.text:

extraSections.title: Without a DAC vs with a DAC
extraSections.text:
- The ‘DAC-free’ version (Mod GRF 1-29) has a short half-life and produces a brief peak, similar to the natural rhythm.

- The DAC-free formulation is preferred to replicate physiological pulsatility and can be combined with a GHRP.

extraSections.title: Pourquoi associer GHRH et GHRP ?
extraSections.text:
La GHRH (CJC-1295) et le GHRP (Ipamorelin) stimulent la GH par deux voies différentes. Les combiner produit un pulse de GH plus fort et plus net qu'avec un seul des deux peptides.
- CJC-1295 (sans DAC) : déclenche le pulse via le récepteur de la GHRH.
- Ipamorelin : amplifie ce pulse via le récepteur de la ghréline, sans effet marqué sur le cortisol ou l'appétit.
- Résultat : réponse GH synergique tout en respectant la pulsatilité naturelle.

en.description: A ghrelin-mimetic peptide reported to be under investigation for its effect on growth hormone secretion. The areas cited include sleep, recovery and body composition.
en.subtitle: Ghrelin-mimetic peptide (GHS-R)
en.intro: Ipamorelin is a ghrelin-mimetic peptide that selectively and physiologically stimulates the secretion of growth hormone (GH) by the pituitary gland, without significantly increasing cortisol, prolactin or appetite. It supports recovery, improves sleep and promotes optimal body composition.

highlights.title: Deep sleep
highlights.text: Improves the quality and duration of deep sleep (stages 3 & 4), which is essential for recovery.

highlights.title: Muscle recovery

mechanism.text: Stimulates the ghrelin receptors (GHS-R) in the pituitary gland to induce the release of GH in a physiological, pulsatile manner.
Stimulates the production of IGF-1, a key factor in regeneration and protein synthesis.
Promotes cell growth and nerve and muscle recovery.
Improves the quality of deep sleep, the phase during which most GH is released.
Helps the body make better use of fats as a source of energy, without stimulating the appetite.

history.title: First selective GH secretagogue
history.text: Raun and his colleagues at Novo Nordisk describe ipamorellin, a pentapeptide derived from GHRP-1, in the *European Journal of Endocrinology*.

history.title: Demonstrated pharmacological selectivity
history.text: Preclinical studies show that GH is released without any significant increase in ACTH, cortisol or prolactin, unlike previous GHRP compounds.

history.title: Clinical gastrointestinal investigations
history.text: The molecule was evaluated in phase 2 trials as a motility agonist, particularly for the treatment of post-operative ileus, but did not result in approval.

history.title: Current status
history.text: Ipamorelline remains an investigational compound and has not been approved as a medicine by the FDA or the EMA.

handling.text: It is best to inject before bedtime (on an empty stomach or after a light meal) to maximise the night-time GH peak.
Maintain a regular sleep routine and limit your exposure to blue light in the evening.
Ensure you get enough protein throughout the day.
Start low, take it slowly, and build up gradually.
Avoid combining with substances that increase cortisol levels.

storage.label: Before reconstitution
storage.text: Store the freeze-dried powder in the fridge (2–8 °C), away from light and moisture (stable for several months to over a year).

storage.label: After reconstruction
storage.text: Store in the fridge (2–8 °C) and use within ~28 days.

storage.label: Note
storage.text: Do not freeze the reconstituted solution; protect it from light and do not leave it at room temperature.

safety.text: Pregnancy and breastfeeding: to be avoided as a precaution (no human data available).
History of cancer or an active tumour, particularly one sensitive to GH/IGF-1: to be avoided; medical advice required.
Diabetes or insulin resistance: monitor blood glucose levels (there may be a reduction in insulin sensitivity specific to the class of GH secretagogues).
Proliferative diabetic retinopathy: caution is advised (class effect linked to elevated GH levels).
Known hypersensitivity to the product; not recommended for use in children and adolescents. Unapproved investigational compound (FDA/EMA).

timeline.text: Easier to fall asleep, slightly deeper sleep, fewer night-time awakenings.
Longer periods of deep sleep, faster muscle recovery, less muscle soreness, and increased energy in the morning.
Improved overall sleep, faster and more complete recovery, and enhanced performance.
Optimal regeneration achieved, improved overall vitality, long-lasting results.

stacks.title: GH axis & body composition
stacks.text:
GHRH + GHRP combination: Tesamorelin (a GHRH analogue) and Ipamorelin (a selective GHRP) stimulate the natural release of GH in a synergistic and pulsatile manner.
Sleep
Tesamorelin (GHRH analogue) — amplitude of the GH peak Ipamorelin (selective GHRP) — triggers its own peak (low levels of ghrelin/cortisol)
Why it works: A GHRH (Tesamorelin) and a GHRP (Ipamorelin) act on two different receptors: when combined, they produce a greater release of GH than the sum of their individual effects, whilst maintaining the physiological pulsatile pattern.
Inject in the evening on an empty stomach to coincide with the nocturnal GH peak.
Monitor for water retention and insulin sensitivity.

stacks.title: Deep sleep & nervous system recovery
stacks.text:
Deep Sleep Support (DSIP) combined with overall recovery via the nocturnal GH axis (Ipamorelin).
DSIP: Delta sleep quality, nervous system relaxation; Ipamorelin: Nocturnal GH peak — recovery during sleep
Why it works: DSIP promotes entry into deep sleep, the phase during which the GH peak naturally occurs and which Ipamorelin amplifies: the combination aims to promote more restorative sleep.
Take 30–60 minutes before bedtime.
Avoid stimulants later in the day so as not to counteract the effect.

sideEffects.text: Studies on GH secretagogues report fluid retention and mild oedema, which are often transient.
The following symptoms may be observed: tingling or numbness in the extremities (symptoms suggestive of carpal tunnel syndrome).
Tiredness or drowsiness, particularly after the evening injection.
Increased appetite linked to the activation of the ghrelin pathway.
Redness or local discomfort at the injection site.
Caution regarding blood glucose levels: a temporary reduction in insulin sensitivity has been reported for this class of medicines. Known hypersensitivity to the product: avoid use.
Pregnancy, breastfeeding and a history of GH-sensitive tumours: exercise caution; consult a healthcare professional if in doubt.

products.intro: Le TB 500 (fragment synthétique de la Thymosine Bêta-4) est un peptide naturellement présent dans le corps humain. Il joue un rôle clé dans la régénération cellulaire, la réparation des tissus, la réduction de l'inflammation et l'amélioration de la mobilité. C'est un fragment synthétique de la Thymosine Beta-4, une protéine naturellement présente dans le corps, largement utilisé pour accélérer la récupération, réduire l'inflammation et améliorer la mobilité. La littérature le décrit comme un soutien à la récupération et aux performances.

mechanism.text: Migration cellulaire : favorise le déplacement des cellules (fibroblastes, cellules endothéliales, cellules souches) vers les zones de blessure/endommagées.
Angiogenèse : stimule la formation de nouveaux vaisseaux sanguins pour améliorer l'apport en oxygène et nutriments.
Réduction de l'inflammation : diminue la production de cytokines inflammatoires et accélère la résolution.
Réparation des tissus : accélère la régénération des muscles, tendons, ligaments, peau et organes.
Protection cellulaire : protège les cellules contre le stress oxydatif, l'apoptose et les dommages causés par les radicaux libres.

history.title: Isolement de la thymosine
history.text: Allan Goldstein et ses collègues isolent des fractions de thymosine à partir d'extraits de thymus, contenant la future Thymosine Bêta-4.

history.title: Séquence complète de la Tβ4
history.text: Low, Hu et Goldstein publient dans PNAS la séquence complète de la Thymosine Bêta-4, un peptide de 43 acides aminés.

history.title: Rôle sur le cytosquelette
history.text: Safer, Goldstein et collègues identifient la Tβ4 comme principal agent séquestrant l'actine-G, expliquant son rôle dans la réparation cellulaire.

history.title: Émergence du fragment TB-500
history.text: Le développement clinique de la Tβ4 par RegeneRx s'accompagne de l'usage en recherche du fragment synthétique TB-500 (séquence LKKTETQ).

history.title: Caractérisation analytique
history.text: Esposito et collègues caractérisent formellement le TB-500 comme composé synthétique défini, distinct de la Tβ4 pleine longueur.

history.title: Essais cliniques de la Tβ4
history.text: La Tβ4 (RGN-259) atteint des essais de phase 2/3 pour l'œil sec et la kératopathie neurotrophique, tandis que le TB-500 reste sans essai clinique humain.

handling.text: Les protocoles décrivent un début à la dose la plus basse efficace, ajustée selon la réponse individuelle.
Faire des cycles avec des pauses de 4 à 6 semaines est décrit dans la littérature.
La régularité est plus importante que la fréquence élevée.
Un bon sommeil (7 à 9h par nuit), une alimentation anti-inflammatoire et une hydratation optimale sont essentiels pour maximiser les résultats.
Le peptide est un catalyseur : l'hygiène de vie en est le multiplicateur.
À éviter : alcool excessif, anti-inflammatoires non stéroïdiens (AINS) en excès, mélanger avec d'autres peptides dans la même seringue.

storage.label: Note

- Système nerveux : favorise la régénération nerveuse et la récupération après lésions.

- Gestion du stress : réduction du cortisol pour favoriser la régénération.

en.intro: TB 500 (a synthetic fragment of Thymosin Beta-4) is a peptide that occurs naturally in the human body. It plays a key role in cell regeneration, tissue repair, reducing inflammation and improving mobility. It is a synthetic fragment of Thymosin Beta-4, a protein naturally present in the body, widely used to speed up recovery, reduce inflammation and improve mobility. The literature describes it as supporting recovery and performance.
en.purityNote: Purity (HPLC) measures the absence of relevant impurities; it is distinct from the net peptide content, as salts and counter-ions (acetate, TFA) contribute to the total mass of the vial. This must be taken into account when calculating the actual concentration upon reconstitution.

highlights.text: Improves joint mobility and flexibility.

mechanism.text: Cell migration: promotes the movement of cells (fibroblasts, endothelial cells, stem cells) to areas of injury or damage.
Angiogenesis: stimulates the formation of new blood vessels to improve the supply of oxygen and nutrients.
Reduction of inflammation: reduces the production of inflammatory cytokines and accelerates resolution.
Tissue repair: accelerates the regeneration of muscles, tendons, ligaments, skin and organs.
Cell protection: protects cells against oxidative stress, apoptosis and damage caused by free radicals.

history.title: Isolation of thymosin
history.text: Allan Goldstein and his colleagues isolated thymosin fractions from thymus extracts, which contained what would later be known as Thymosin Beta-4.

history.title: Full sequence of Tβ4
history.text: Low, Hu and Goldstein have published the complete sequence of Thymosin Beta-4, a 43-amino-acid peptide, in PNAS.

history.title: Role in the cytoskeleton
history.text: Safer, Goldstein and colleagues have identified Tβ4 as the main agent responsible for sequestering G-actin, thereby explaining its role in cell repair.

history.title: The emergence of the TB-500 fragment
history.text: RegeneRx’s clinical development of Tβ4 is accompanied by the use of the synthetic fragment TB-500 (sequence LKKTETQ) in research.

history.title: Analytical characterisation
history.text: Esposito and colleagues formally characterise TB-500 as a well-defined synthetic compound, distinct from full-length Tβ4.

history.title: Clinical trials of Tβ4
history.text: Tβ4 (RGN-259) has reached Phase 2/3 trials for dry eye and neurotrophic keratopathy, whilst TB-500 has yet to enter human clinical trials.

handling.text: The protocols describe starting treatment at the lowest effective dose, adjusted according to the individual’s response.
The literature describes treatment cycles with breaks of 4 to 6 weeks.
Consistency is more important than high frequency.

extraSections.title: What is TB-500?
extraSections.text:
TB-500 is a synthetic fragment of Thymosin Beta-4, a protein naturally present in the human body that is involved in tissue repair and regeneration.
- Origin: fragment of a natural human protein (Thymosin Beta-4).
- Main function: tissue repair and regeneration.
- Form: freeze-dried (powder).
- Molecular weight: ~ 4966 Da.
- Sequence: AcSDKPDMAEIEKFDKSKLKKTETQEKNPLPSKETIEEQKQAGES.

extraSections.title: Areas and targets for action
extraSections.text:
The TB 500 acts on a wide range of tissues and systems.
- Musculoskeletal system: muscles, tendons, ligaments, fasciae and joints (shoulders, knees, ankles, back).
- Skin and soft tissues: improves the healing of wounds, burns and skin lesions.
- Cardiovascular system: formation of new blood vessels and tissue repair.
- Nervous system: promotes nerve regeneration and recovery following injury.
- Common applications: sports injuries, post-operative recovery, tendinitis, rehabilitation.
- General health: improves resilience to physical and inflammatory stress.

products.name: Épitalon (Epithalon / Epithalone)
products.description: Tétrapeptide de synthèse (Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly) dérivé de l’épithalamine. Les axes de recherche évoqués incluent la télomérase, la mélatonine et les rythmes circadiens.
products.subtitle: Epithalon / Epithalone — tétrapeptide pinéal (Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly)
products.intro: L'Épitalon (Epithalon / Epithalone) est un tétrapeptide de synthèse (Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly) dérivé de l'épithalamine, un extrait peptidique de la glande pinéale. Il est étudié à visée recherche pour son influence sur l'activité de la télomérase, enzyme impliquée dans le maintien de la longueur des télomères, ainsi que pour son rôle dans la régulation de la sécrétion de mélatonine et du rythme circadien. Administré par voie sous-cutanée, il est généralement utilisé lors de cures courtes et répétées (10 à 20 jours, 1 à 2 fois par an) plutôt qu'en usage continu.

mechanism.text: Tétrapeptide (Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly) dérivé de l'épithalamine, un extrait peptidique de la glande pinéale bovine.
Stimule l'activité de la télomérase, l'enzyme qui régule l'allongement des télomères aux extrémités des chromosomes.
Restaure en partie la fonction pinéale et la sécrétion physiologique de mélatonine, souvent réduite avec l'âge.
Module l'expression de certains gènes liés au cycle cellulaire et à la sénescence.
Influence l'activité de l'interleukine-2 et de certaines enzymes (dont l'acétylcholinestérase), suggérant une action systémique plus large que la seule sphère pinéale.

extraSections.text:
L'Épitalon est un tétrapeptide de synthèse reproduisant la séquence active de l'épithalamine, un extrait peptidique de la glande pinéale. Il est étudié principalement pour son influence sur le vieillissement cellulaire et la fonction pinéale.
- Tétrapeptide de 4 acides aminés : Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly (AEDG).
- Dérivé synthétique de l'épithalamine (extrait de glande pinéale bovine).
- Étudié pour son action sur la télomérase et la régulation de la mélatonine.
- Utilisé en recherche sous forme de cures courtes et répétées, plutôt qu'en continu.

en.description: A synthetic tetrapeptide (Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly) derived from epithalamine. The areas of research mentioned include telomerase, melatonin and circadian rhythms.
en.subtitle: Epithalon / Epithalone — pineal tetrapeptide (Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly)
en.intro: Epithalon (Epithalon / Epithalone) is a synthetic tetrapeptide (Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly) derived from epithalamine, a peptide extract from the pineal gland. It is currently being studied for its potential influence on the activity of telomerase, an enzyme involved in maintaining telomere length, as well as for its role in regulating melatonin secretion and the circadian rhythm. Administered subcutaneously, it is generally used in short, repeated courses of treatment (10 to 20 days, once or twice a year) rather than on a continuous basis.
en.purityNote: Purity (HPLC) measures the absence of relevant impurities; it is distinct from the net peptide content, as salts and counter-ions (acetate, TFA) contribute to the total mass of the vial. This must be taken into account when calculating the actual concentration upon reconstitution.

highlights.title: Telomerase activation
highlights.text: Promotes the activity of telomerase, an enzyme involved in maintaining telomere length.

highlights.title: Regulation of melatonin
highlights.text: Supports the function of the pineal gland and the natural production of melatonin.

highlights.title: Circadian rhythm
highlights.text: Helps regulate the sleep-wake cycle and synchronise the body clock.

highlights.title: Sleep quality
highlights.text: May promote deeper, more restorative sleep, particularly when sleep is disrupted.

highlights.title: Cellular longevity
highlights.text: Forms part of research into healthy cellular ageing and chromosome protection.

highlights.title: Immune modulation
highlights.text: Studied for its potential to support the immune response through its action on interleukin-2.

mechanism.text: Tetrapeptide (Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly) derived from epithalamine, a peptide extract from the bovine pineal gland.
Stimulates the activity of telomerase, the enzyme that regulates the lengthening of telomeres at the ends of chromosomes.
Partially restores pineal function and the physiological secretion of melatonin, which is often reduced with age.
It modulates the expression of certain genes associated with the cell cycle and senescence.
It influences the activity of interleukin-2 and certain enzymes (including acetylcholinesterase), suggesting a systemic effect that extends beyond the pineal gland alone.

history.title: Origin in the Epithalamion
history.text: Vladimir Khavinson is developing Epithalamine in Russia, a polypeptide extract from the bovine pineal gland, which forms the conceptual basis for Epitalon.

history.title: Synthesis of the tetrapeptide
history.text: Épitalon (Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly, AEDG) is synthesised as a short analogue that replicates the activity of the pineal extract.

history.title: Telomerase activation
history.text: Khavinson and his colleagues report the induction of telomerase and telomere lengthening in cultured human somatic cells.

history.title: Unapproved peptide
history.text: Épitalon remains a peptide under investigation; the data on it come mainly from Khavinson’s group and it has not received any regulatory approval.

handling.text: It is best to take the injection in the evening, 1 to 2 hours before bedtime, to coincide with the natural peak in melatonin levels.
Follow short courses of treatment (10 to 20 days), repeated once or twice a year, rather than using the product continuously.
Reconstitute carefully and store the solution in the fridge between injections.
Start with the lowest dose within the recommended range to assess individual tolerance.
Maintain good sleep hygiene (darkness, regular sleep patterns) to maximise the effect on the circadian rhythm.

storage.label: Before reconstitution
storage.text: Store the freeze-dried powder in the fridge (2–8 °C), away from light and moisture.

storage.label: After reconstruction
storage.text: Store in the fridge (2–8 °C) and use whilst undergoing treatment (within ~28 days).

storage.label: Note
storage.text: Do not freeze the reconstituted solution; protect it from light.

safety.text: Pregnancy and breastfeeding: avoid as a precaution.
History of tumour-related conditions or active cancer: caution is advised and medical advice is required (due to effects on telomerase and the cell cycle).
If you are currently undergoing hormone treatment, seek medical advice before use.
Known hypersensitivity to the compound; use is not recommended in children.
An investigational compound not yet approved (by the FDA/EMA), with data derived predominantly from a single research group.

timeline.text: A gradual improvement in the quality of sleep and the feeling of having recovered overnight.
A sleep-wake cycle that is often perceived as more regular, with more stable energy levels throughout the day.
Effects reported to persist beyond the period of administration, despite the peptide’s short half-life.

timeline.period: Over the course of several treatment courses (1 to 2 per year)
timeline.text: Aim: to provide long-term, cumulative support for healthy cellular ageing.

synergies.text: Possible synergy between the regulation of the circadian rhythm and sleep quality.
Commonly used as part of a holistic approach to cellular longevity. View the factsheet & add →
A combination sometimes used in anti-ageing research, across complementary areas (skin and cellular). View the factsheet & add →

sideEffects.text: A peptide that is generally well tolerated during short courses of treatment.
Redness, mild pain or temporary discomfort at the injection site.
Drowsiness or a feeling of tiredness may occur, particularly if the injection is administered late.
Some users have reported occasional headaches or dizziness.
Pregnancy and breastfeeding: avoid as a precaution.
History of cancer or current hormone therapy: seek medical advice before use.

extraSections.title: What is Épitalon?
extraSections.text:
Épitalon is a synthetic tetrapeptide that replicates the active sequence of epithalamine, a peptide extract from the pineal gland. It is primarily being studied for its effect on cellular ageing and pineal function.
- A tetrapeptide consisting of 4 amino acids: Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly (AEDG).
- A synthetic derivative of epithalamine (extracted from the bovine pineal gland).
- Studied for its effect on telomerase and the regulation of melatonin.
- Used in research in the form of short, repeated courses of treatment, rather than continuously.

dosage.timing: Ideally in the evening, 1 to 2 hours before bedtime, to coincide with the physiological peak in melatonin levels; taken daily for the duration of the course of treatment
dosage.halfLife: Very short plasma half-life (in the order of a few minutes); the reported effects persist beyond the peptide’s presence in the blood, which justifies repeated short courses of treatment.
dosage.disclaimer: Information taken from the cited source: figures published for information purposes only; not medically validated. These are neither recommendations nor treatment instructions.

reconstitution.originalText: 10 mg vial + 2 ml BAC water = 5 mg/ml

relatedSections.title: Recommended dilution (10 mg vial, U-100 syringe)
relatedSections.text:
- 2 ml of BAC → 5 mg/ml → 100 units = 5 mg (standard protocol).
- 1 ml of BAC → 10 mg/ml → injection volume halved for the same dose.
- For a 5 mg dose: approximately 100 units at 5 mg/ml, or 50 units at 10 mg/ml.
- Store the reconstituted solution in the fridge and use it within the recommended time frame.

relatedSections.title: Treatment courses and frequency of use
relatedSections.text:
Unlike many peptides that are used on a continuous basis, Épitalon is generally administered in short, intensive courses of treatment.
- Typical course of treatment: 10 to 20 consecutive days, with one injection per day.
- 1 to 2 courses of treatment per year, spaced several months apart.
- Regularity of injections during the course of treatment is more important than high doses.

products.name: Glutathion (GSH)
products.description: Tripeptide composé de glutamate, cystéine et glycine, décrit comme un antioxydant naturellement présent dans l’organisme. Il est associé à la défense contre le stress oxydatif et à l’équilibre redox.
products.subtitle: Tripeptide antioxydant (GSH)
products.intro: Le glutathion (GSH) est un tripeptide composé de glutamate, cystéine et glycine, considéré comme l'antioxydant majeur produit naturellement par l'organisme. Présent dans toutes les cellules, il participe à la défense contre le stress oxydatif, à la détoxification hépatique et au maintien de l'équilibre redox intracellulaire.
products.purityNote: La pureté (HPLC) mesure l'absence d'impuretés apparentées ; elle est distincte de la teneur nette en peptide, car les sels et contre-ions (acétate, TFA) comptent dans la masse du flacon. À prendre en compte pour la concentration réelle à la reconstitution.

highlights.title: Défense antioxydante
highlights.text: Neutralise les radicaux libres et les espèces réactives de l'oxygène, protégeant les cellules du stress oxydatif.

highlights.title: Détoxification hépatique
highlights.text: Soutient la conjugaison hépatique et l'élimination de certaines toxines et métabolites.

highlights.title: Équilibre redox
highlights.text: Contribue au maintien du rapport glutathion réduit/oxydé, central pour l'homéostasie cellulaire.

highlights.title: Éclat cutané
highlights.text: Souvent associé à un teint plus uniforme et lumineux, en lien avec son activité sur le stress oxydatif.

mechanism.text: Le glutathion réduit (GSH) cède un électron pour neutraliser les radicaux libres et se transforme en glutathion oxydé (GSSG).
La glutathion peroxydase utilise le GSH pour détoxifier le peroxyde d'hydrogène et les hydroperoxydes lipidiques.
Cofacteur des glutathion-S-transférases : conjugaison des xénobiotiques et toxines pour faciliter leur élimination (phase II hépatique).
Régénération du GSSG en GSH par la glutathion réductase, dépendante du NADPH ; recyclage assuré par le cycle redox cellulaire.
Régénère et est régénéré par d'autres antioxydants (vitamine C, vitamine E) au sein du réseau antioxydant.

history.title: Découverte de la « philothion »
history.text: Le chimiste français de Rey-Pailhade identifie dans la levure une substance soufrée réactive qu'il nomme philothion.

history.title: Isolement par Hopkins
history.text: Frederick Gowland Hopkins extrait le composé des tissus, le renomme glutathion et le décrit d'abord à tort comme un dipeptide.

history.title: Structure tripeptidique établie
history.text: Hopkins réexamine la molécule et confirme qu'il s'agit d'un tripeptide de glutamate, cystéine et glycine.

history.title: Première synthèse chimique
history.text: Harington et Mead réalisent la synthèse totale du glutathion, confirmant définitivement sa structure.

handling.text: Associer à des précurseurs (N-acétylcystéine) qui apportent la cystéine, acide aminé limitant de la synthèse du GSH.
La vitamine C aide à maintenir le glutathion sous sa forme réduite (active).
Une alimentation riche en soufre (crucifères, ail, œufs) soutient la production endogène.
Limiter les facteurs qui épuisent le glutathion : alcool, tabac, stress oxydatif chronique.
Sommeil et activité physique régulière participent au maintien du réseau antioxydant.
Tenir un journal : ressenti, sommeil, énergie, état cutané.

storage.label: Avant reconstitution
storage.text: poudre lyophilisée au réfrigérateur (2-8 °C), à l'abri de la lumière et de l'air.

storage.label: Après reconstitution
storage.text: conserver au réfrigérateur (2-8 °C), à l'abri de la lumière ; utiliser dans un délai court (le glutathion réduit s'oxyde facilement).

storage.label: Note
storage.text: Éviter chaleur, lumière et cycles de congélation/décongélation ; jeter toute solution jaunie ou trouble.

safety.text: Hypersensibilité connue au glutathion réduit ou à un excipient.
Grossesse et allaitement (sécurité non établie).
Insuffisance hépatique ou rénale sévère : sécurité non établie, surveillance médicale requise.
Asthme : de rares réactions bronchospastiques ont été décrites, prudence.
Éclaircissement cutané avec usage prolongé : innocuité à long terme peu documentée.

dosage.timing: À jeun le matin (2 fois par semaine)
dosage.halfLife: Le glutathion injecté a une demi-vie plasmatique très courte (environ 10-15 min en IV chez l'humain) ; l'effet repose sur le maintien du réseau antioxydant plutôt que sur une présence prolongée.

reconstitution.originalText: 600 mg fiole + 3 ml eau BAC = 200 mg/ml

relatedSections.title: Rôle physiologique
relatedSections.text: Le glutathion est présent dans quasiment toutes les cellules et agit comme antioxydant intracellulaire majeur. Son niveau reflète en partie l'état oxydatif de l'organisme et tend à diminuer avec l'âge, le stress et certaines expositions.

relatedSections.title: Cycle redox et régénération
relatedSections.text:
- GSH (réduit) → GSSG (oxydé) lors de la neutralisation des radicaux libres.
- GSSG → GSH via la glutathion réductase, dépendante du NADPH.
- Interaction étroite avec vitamine C, vitamine E et NAC pour maintenir la capacité antioxydante.

relatedSections.title: Signes à surveiller
relatedSections.text:
- Positifs : confort général, teint plus lumineux, bonne tolérance locale.
- À ajuster : réactions au point d'injection, inconfort digestif, éruption cutanée.

relatedSections.title: Règle d'or
relatedSections.text: Le glutathion s'inscrit dans une hygiène de vie globale (sommeil, alimentation, réduction des expositions oxydantes) plutôt que comme solution isolée. Contenu informatif ; ne remplace pas un avis médical.

timeline.text: Phase initiale : soutien de la charge antioxydante, effets subjectifs variables selon les individus.
Stabilisation : certains rapportent un teint plus lumineux et une sensation d'énergie ou de récupération améliorée.
Entretien : effets progressifs sur le confort général ; l'intérêt dépend du statut oxydatif de base et de l'hygiène de vie.

synergies.title: N-acétylcystéine (NAC)
synergies.text: Fournit la cystéine, acide aminé limitant, et favorise la synthèse endogène de glutathion.

synergies.title: Vitamine C
synergies.text: Aide à régénérer le glutathion sous sa forme réduite et renforce le réseau antioxydant.

synergies.title: Acide alpha-lipoïque
synergies.text: Antioxydant qui participe au recyclage du glutathion et d'autres antioxydants.

sideEffects.text: Généralement bien toléré ; réactions locales possibles au point d'injection (rougeur, sensibilité).
Ballonnements ou inconfort digestif transitoire chez certaines personnes.
Réactions cutanées ou allergiques rares (démangeaisons, éruption).
Un éclaircissement cutané peut survenir avec un usage prolongé ; son innocuité à long terme reste peu documentée.
À surveiller (consulter si sévère/persistant) : réaction allergique marquée, éruption étendue, gêne respiratoire.

en.description: A tripeptide composed of glutamate, cysteine and glycine, described as an antioxidant naturally present in the body. It is associated with defence against oxidative stress and with redox balance.
en.subtitle: Antioxidant tripeptide (GSH)
en.intro: Glutathione (GSH) is a tripeptide composed of glutamate, cysteine and glycine, and is regarded as the body’s primary naturally occurring antioxidant. Found in all cells, it plays a role in defending against oxidative stress, in liver detoxification and in maintaining intracellular redox balance.
en.purityNote: Purity (HPLC) measures the absence of relevant impurities; it is distinct from the net peptide content, as salts and counter-ions (acetate, TFA) contribute to the total mass of the vial. This must be taken into account when calculating the actual concentration upon reconstitution.

highlights.title: Antioxidant defence
highlights.text: Neutralises free radicals and reactive oxygen species, protecting cells from oxidative stress.

highlights.title: Liver detoxification
highlights.text: Supports hepatic conjugation and the elimination of certain toxins and metabolites.

highlights.title: Redox balance
highlights.text: Helps maintain the reduced/oxidised glutathione ratio, which is essential for cellular homeostasis.

highlights.title: Skin radiance
highlights.text: It is often associated with a more even and radiant complexion, due to its effect on oxidative stress.

mechanism.text: Reduced glutathione (GSH) donates an electron to neutralise free radicals and is converted into oxidised glutathione (GSSG).
Glutathione peroxidase uses GSH to detoxify hydrogen peroxide and lipid hydroperoxides.
Cofactor for glutathione-S-transferases: conjugation of xenobiotics and toxins to facilitate their elimination (phase II metabolism in the liver).
Regeneration of GSSG to GSH by NADPH-dependent glutathione reductase; recycling is facilitated by the cellular redox cycle.
It regenerates and is regenerated by other antioxidants (vitamin C, vitamin E) within the antioxidant network.

history.title: The discovery of ‘philothion’
history.text: The French chemist de Rey-Pailhade identified a reactive sulphur-containing substance in yeast, which he named philothion.

history.title: Hopkins’ isolation
history.text: Frederick Gowland Hopkins isolated the compound from tissue, renamed it glutathione and initially misidentified it as a dipeptide.

history.title: Tripeptide structure determined
history.text: Hopkins re-examined the molecule and confirmed that it is a tripeptide consisting of glutamate, cysteine and glycine.

history.title: First chemical synthesis
history.text: Harington and Mead carried out the total synthesis of glutathione, definitively confirming its structure.

handling.text: Combine with precursors (N-acetylcysteine) that provide cysteine, the limiting amino acid in GSH synthesis.
Vitamin C helps to maintain glutathione in its reduced (active) form.
A diet rich in sulphur (cruciferous vegetables, garlic, eggs) supports the body’s own production.
Minimise factors that deplete glutathione: alcohol, tobacco and chronic oxidative stress.
Sleep and regular physical activity help to maintain the antioxidant defence system.
Keep a diary: how you feel, sleep, energy levels, skin condition.

storage.label: Before reconstitution
storage.text: Store the freeze-dried powder in the fridge (2–8 °C), protected from light and air.

storage.label: After reconstruction
storage.text: Store in the fridge (2–8 °C), away from light; use within a short period (reduced glutathione oxidises easily).

storage.label: Note
storage.text: Avoid heat, light and freeze-thaw cycles; discard any solution that has turned yellow or become cloudy.

safety.text: Known hypersensitivity to reduced glutathione or to any of the excipients.
Pregnancy and breastfeeding (safety not established).
Severe liver or kidney impairment: safety not established; medical supervision required.
Asthma: rare cases of bronchospasm have been reported; caution is advised.
Skin lightening with prolonged use: there is little evidence regarding long-term safety.

timeline.text: Initial phase: support for antioxidant capacity; subjective effects vary from person to person.
Stabilisation: some users report a more radiant complexion and a feeling of increased energy or improved recovery.
Maintenance: gradual effects on general well-being; the benefits depend on one’s baseline oxidative status and lifestyle.

synergies.text: Provides cysteine, a rate-limiting amino acid, and promotes the endogenous synthesis of glutathione.
Helps to regenerate glutathione in its reduced form and strengthens the antioxidant defence system.
An antioxidant that plays a role in the recycling of glutathione and other antioxidants.

sideEffects.text: Generally well tolerated; local reactions may occur at the injection site (redness, tenderness).
Bloating or temporary digestive discomfort in some people.
Rare skin or allergic reactions (itching, rash).
Skin lightening may occur with prolonged use; its long-term safety remains poorly documented.
Things to watch out for (seek medical advice if severe or persistent): a severe allergic reaction, a widespread rash, breathing difficulties.

dosage.timing: On an empty stomach in the morning (twice a week)
dosage.halfLife: Injected glutathione has a very short plasma half-life (approximately 10–15 minutes when administered intravenously in humans); its effect is based on maintaining the antioxidant network rather than on its prolonged presence.
dosage.disclaimer: Information taken from the cited source: figures published for information purposes only; not medically validated. These are neither recommendations nor treatment instructions.

reconstitution.originalText: 600 mg vial + 3 ml water BAC = 200 mg/ml

relatedSections.title: Physiological role
relatedSections.text: Glutathione is present in virtually all cells and acts as a major intracellular antioxidant. Its level partly reflects the body’s oxidative status and tends to decrease with age, stress and certain types of exposure.

relatedSections.title: Redox cycle and regeneration
relatedSections.text:
- GSH (reduced) → GSSG (oxidised) during the neutralisation of free radicals.
- GSSG → GSH via NADPH-dependent glutathione reductase.
- Works closely with vitamin C, vitamin E and NAC to maintain antioxidant capacity.

relatedSections.title: Signs to look out for
relatedSections.text:
- Positive aspects: overall comfort, a more radiant complexion, good local tolerance.
- Areas for improvement: reactions at the injection site, digestive discomfort, skin rash.

relatedSections.title: Golden Rule
relatedSections.text: Glutathione forms part of an overall healthy lifestyle (sleep, diet, reducing exposure to oxidative stress) rather than being a stand-alone solution. This is for information purposes only; it is not a substitute for medical advice.

products.name: NAD+
products.description: Coenzyme naturellement présente dans les cellules, impliquée dans la production d’énergie cellulaire et différents processus biologiques. Elle est présentée dans le contexte de la fonction cellulaire et du métabolisme énergétique.
products.subtitle: Nicotinamide Adénine Dinucléotide
products.intro: Le NAD+ (Nicotinamide Adénine Dinucléotide) est une coenzyme naturellement présente dans toutes nos cellules. Elle joue un rôle essentiel dans la production d'énergie cellulaire (ATP), la réparation de l'ADN et la régulation de nombreux processus biologiques fondamentaux. Le NAD+ agit comme un véritable « carburant moléculaire », permettant à nos cellules de convertir les nutriments en énergie utilisable. Ses niveaux chutent de plus de 50% entre 30 et 60 ans, ce qui peut contribuer à la fatigue, un déclin cognitif et une baisse de performance. Maintenir des niveaux optimaux soutient l'énergie, la récupération, la longévité et la santé cellulaire à long terme.
products.purityNote: La pureté (HPLC) mesure l'absence d'impuretés apparentées ; elle est distincte de la teneur nette en peptide, car les sels et contre-ions (acétate, TFA) comptent dans la masse du flacon. À prendre en compte pour la concentration réelle à la reconstitution.

highlights.title: Énergie cellulaire
highlights.text: Soutient la production d'ATP et combat la fatigue.

highlights.title: Clarté mentale
highlights.text: Favorise la fonction cognitive, la concentration et la mémoire.

highlights.title: Récupération optimale
highlights.text: Accélère la récupération énergétique et réduit le stress oxydatif.

highlights.title: Longévité cellulaire
highlights.text: Active les sirtuines et soutient la réparation cellulaire pour un vieillissement sain.

highlights.title: Performance & endurance
highlights.text: Améliore la résilience, l'endurance et les performances.

highlights.title: Résilience globale
highlights.text: Renforce l'adaptation au stress et la santé cellulaire globale.

mechanism.text: Coenzyme indispensable à la production d'ATP dans les mitochondries, source principale d'énergie cellulaire.
Intervient dans le cycle de Krebs et la chaîne respiratoire mitochondriale pour convertir les nutriments en énergie utilisable.
Active les enzymes PARP qui détectent et réparent les cassures de l'ADN, préservant l'intégrité génétique.
Active les sirtuines, protéines dépendantes du NAD+ qui régulent l'expression de gènes liés à la longévité, à la réparation et à la résistance au stress.
Améliore la biogenèse mitochondriale et l'efficacité énergétique, limitant le déclin fonctionnel lié à l'âge.
Soutient les défenses antioxydantes naturelles et limite les dommages oxydatifs (équilibre redox).

history.title: Découverte de la cozymase
history.text: Arthur Harden et William Young observent qu'un facteur thermostable de la levure accélère la fermentation, qu'ils nomment « coferment » (cozymase), futur NAD+.

history.title: Prix Nobel de chimie
history.text: Harden et Hans von Euler-Chelpin reçoivent le Nobel de chimie pour leurs travaux sur la fermentation des sucres et la cozymase.

history.title: Rôle redox établi
history.text: Otto Warburg démontre que le NAD+ intervient dans les réactions d'oxydoréduction par transfert d'hydrure, identifiant le cycle pyridine actif.

history.title: Lien NAD+ et vieillissement
history.text: Imai et Guarente montrent que la protéine Sir2 est une désacétylase dépendante du NAD+, reliant directement le métabolisme du NAD+ au vieillissement.

history.title: NAD+ et longévité
history.text: Les précurseurs du NAD+ (nicotinamide riboside, NMN) sont étudiés et commercialisés comme compléments visant à restaurer le NAD+ décliné avec l'âge.

handling.text: Une bonne hydratation (2 à 3 L/j décrits dans la littérature) est associée à une meilleure absorption, au transport et à l'élimination des toxines.
Les protocoles décrivent un début très bas (20 à 25 mg en sous-cutané) puis une augmentation progressive selon la tolérance : le NAD+ pique/brûle à l'injection.

En sous-cutané, ne pas dépasser ~150 mg par injection. Les doses plus élevées (250 à 500 mg et plus) se font uniquement en perfusion intraveineuse (IV) LENTE (2 à 4 h) en milieu médical — jamais en injection sous-cutanée rapide.
Les protocoles décrivent une injection très lente, avec un changement de site régulier pour limiter la sensation de brûlure.
La régularité est la clé : les effets sont cumulatifs et s'optimisent dans la durée.
Combinez avec un mode de vie sain : alimentation, entraînement, sommeil et gestion du stress.

storage.label: Avant reconstitution

en.description: A coenzyme naturally present in cells, involved in cellular energy production and various biological processes. It is discussed in the context of cellular function and energy metabolism.
en.subtitle: Nicotinamide Adenine Dinucleotide
en.intro: NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) is a coenzyme naturally present in all our cells. It plays a vital role in cellular energy production (ATP), DNA repair and the regulation of many fundamental biological processes. NAD+ acts as a true ‘molecular fuel’, enabling our cells to convert nutrients into usable energy. Its levels fall by more than 50 per cent between the ages of 30 and 60, which can contribute to fatigue, cognitive decline and reduced performance. Maintaining optimal levels supports energy, recovery, longevity and long-term cellular health.
en.purityNote: Purity (HPLC) measures the absence of relevant impurities; it is distinct from the net peptide content, as salts and counter-ions (acetate, TFA) contribute to the total mass of the vial. This must be taken into account when calculating the actual concentration upon reconstitution.

mechanism.text: A coenzyme essential for the production of ATP in the mitochondria, the main source of cellular energy.
Plays a role in the Krebs cycle and the mitochondrial respiratory chain to convert nutrients into usable energy.
Activates PARP enzymes, which detect and repair DNA breaks, thereby preserving genetic integrity.
Activates sirtuins, NAD+-dependent proteins that regulate the expression of genes linked to longevity, repair and stress resistance.
Improves mitochondrial biogenesis and energy efficiency, thereby limiting age-related functional decline.
Supports the body’s natural antioxidant defences and helps limit oxidative damage (redox balance).

history.title: The discovery of cozymase
history.text: Arthur Harden and William Young observed that a heat-stable factor in yeast accelerates fermentation; they named this ‘coferment’ (cozymase), which would later be identified as NAD+.

history.title: Nobel Prize in Chemistry
history.text: Harden and Hans von Euler-Chelpin were awarded the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for their work on the fermentation of sugars and cozymase.

history.title: Redox role established
history.text: Otto Warburg demonstrated that NAD+ is involved in hydride-transfer redox reactions, thereby identifying the active pyridine cycle.

history.title: The link between NAD+ and ageing
history.text: Imai and Guarente demonstrate that the Sir2 protein is an NAD+-dependent deacetylase, thereby establishing a direct link between NAD+ metabolism and ageing.

history.title: NAD+ and longevity
history.text: NAD+ precursors (nicotinamide riboside, NMN) are being researched and marketed as supplements designed to restore NAD+ levels, which decline with age.

handling.text: Adequate hydration (2 to 3 litres per day, as described in the literature) is associated with improved absorption, transport and elimination of toxins.
The protocols describe starting with a very low dose (20 to 25 mg subcutaneously) followed by a gradual increase depending on tolerance: NAD+ causes a stinging or burning sensation on injection.

For subcutaneous administration, do not exceed ~150 mg per injection. Higher doses (250 to 500 mg and above) must only be administered by SLOW intravenous (IV) infusion (2 to 4 hours) in a medical setting — never as a rapid subcutaneous injection.
The protocols describe a very slow injection, with the injection site changed regularly to minimise the burning sensation.
Consistency is key: the effects are cumulative and improve over time.
Combine this with a healthy lifestyle: diet, exercise, sleep and stress management.

history.text: Loren Pickart isole le tripeptide glycyl-L-histidyl-L-lysine (GHK) du plasma humain en étudiant des facteurs de régénération tissulaire.

extraSections.title: Qu'est-ce que le GHK-Cu ?
extraSections.text:
Le GHK-Cu est un peptide de signalisation naturellement présent dans le corps, qui se lie au cuivre pour activer les processus de réparation et de régénération des tissus. Il amplifie les efforts sans les remplacer.
- Origine : peptide humain naturel (plasma, urine, salive), complexé au cuivre.
- Fonction principale : signalisation de la réparation, du remodelage et de la régénération tissulaire.
- Concerne hommes et femmes, à tout âge (peau, cheveux, récupération).
- Ce n'est ni un stéroïde, ni un produit à effet immédiat ou miracle.
- Ce n'est pas un substitut à une bonne hygiène de vie.

extraSections.title: Domaines et cibles d'action
extraSections.text:
Le GHK-Cu agit sur plusieurs tissus, de l'apparence cutanée à la récupération globale.
- Peau : stimule collagène et élastine, affine le grain, hydrate et renforce la barrière cutanée.
- Anti-âge : améliore fermeté et élasticité, atténue rougeurs et ridules.
- Cheveux & cuir chevelu : prolonge la phase anagène, renforce les follicules, améliore la micro-circulation.
- Régénération tissulaire : soutient cicatrisation, remodelage et intégrité de la matrice extracellulaire.
- Récupération & résilience : soutient tendons, ligaments et retour à l'équilibre après l'effort.
- Le GHK-Cu ne masque pas les dommages : c'est un accélérateur biologique de la réparation.

- Routine douce et cohérente, sans actifs agressifs mal adaptés.
- Soutien de l'intérieur : eau, sommeil réparateur, gestion du stress, nutrition.
- Apport suffisant en protéines et cofacteurs (zinc, fer, cuivre, sélénium, vitamines B).
- Pour les cheveux : le microneedling du cuir chevelu améliore l'absorption.

en.description: A copper-binding signalling peptide. It is associated with research into tissue repair, collagen, elastin, and the quality of the skin and hair.
en.subtitle: Glycyl-L-histidyl-L-lysine copper
en.intro: GHK-Cu (Glycyl-L-Histidyl-L-Lysine Copper) is a peptide naturally present in the human body, found in plasma, urine and saliva. A signalling peptide which, by binding to copper, activates essential biological processes: tissue repair and regeneration, stimulation of collagen and elastin, improvement in skin quality, support for hair growth and reduction of inflammation. A versatile peptide with profound effects on the skin, hair and overall recovery.
en.purityNote: Purity (HPLC) measures the absence of relevant impurities; it is distinct from the net peptide content, as salts and counter-ions (acetate, TFA) contribute to the total mass of the vial. This must be taken into account when calculating the actual concentration upon reconstitution.

mechanism.text: Signalling: GHK-Cu binds to copper and enters the cells.
Activation: it activates genes involved in repair and regeneration.

history.title: Pickart’s discovery of GHK
history.text: Loren Pickart isolated the tripeptide glycyl-L-histidyl-L-lysine (GHK) from human plasma whilst studying factors involved in tissue regeneration.

history.title: Formation of the copper complex
history.text: It has been established that GHK has a high affinity for copper, forming the GHK-Cu complex, which accelerates wound healing.

history.title: Matrix and cosmetic stimulation
history.text: Studies show that GHK-Cu stimulates the synthesis of collagen and glycosaminoglycans, opening up its use in skincare.

history.title: Modulation of gene expression
history.text: Research is examining the effect of GHK-Cu on the expression of genes linked to tissue repair, inflammation and antioxidant activity.

history.title: Review articles
history.text: Pickart publishes reviews summarising the effects of GHK-Cu on oxidative stress, ageing and tissue repair.

Use SPF 30+ sun cream every day.
Combine this with a gentle, consistent routine.
Supporting the skin from within (water, sleep, nutrition).

A gradual approach: start with a low dose and increase it gradually to assess tolerance (weeks 1–2), adaptation (weeks 3–6) and optimisation (weeks 6+).
Take the bottle out of the fridge 10 minutes before use.
Use a new, sterile syringe for each injection and inject slowly.

For hair: scalp microneedling (improves absorption), an adequate intake of protein and amino acids, zinc, iron, copper, selenium and B vitamins.

stacks.title: Skin, radiance & anti-ageing
stacks.text:
Two-stage skin regeneration: GHK-Cu remodels collagen whilst KPV soothes skin inflammation.
GHK-Cu: Collagen, firmness, healing, radiance; KPV: Anti-inflammatory for the skin — soothes redness and irritation
Why it works: GHK-Cu stimulates collagen remodelling and skin repair whilst KPV calms inflammation: this combination aims to achieve clearer, firmer and soothed skin. Two distinct molecules, with no overlap.

extraSections.title: What is GHK-Cu?
extraSections.text:
GHK-Cu is a signalling peptide naturally present in the body, which binds to copper to activate tissue repair and regeneration processes. It enhances these processes without replacing them.
- Origin: natural human peptide (plasma, urine, saliva), complexed with copper.
- Main function: signalling tissue repair, remodelling and regeneration.
- Suitable for men and women of all ages (skin, hair, recovery).
- It is neither a steroid nor a product with immediate or ‘miracle’ effects.
- It is not a substitute for a healthy lifestyle.

extraSections.title: Areas and targets for action
extraSections.text:
GHK-Cu has an effect on a range of tissues, from skin appearance to overall recovery.
- Skin: stimulates collagen and elastin, refines skin texture, moisturises and strengthens the skin barrier.
- Anti-ageing: improves firmness and elasticity, reduces redness and fine lines.
- Hair & scalp: prolongs the anagen phase, strengthens follicles and improves microcirculation.
- Tissue regeneration: supports healing, remodelling and the integrity of the extracellular matrix.
- Recovery & resilience: supports tendons and ligaments and helps restore balance after exercise.
- GHK-Cu does not mask damage: it is a biological accelerator of repair.

extraSections.title: Optimising results
extraSections.text:
The effects of GHK-Cu are described as being optimised by a holistic approach.
- Daily skin hydration and sun protection (SPF 30+).
- A gentle and consistent skincare routine, free from harsh, unsuitable active ingredients.
- Support from within: water, restful sleep, stress management, nutrition.
- Adequate intake of protein and cofactors (zinc, iron, copper, selenium, B vitamins).
- For the hair: scalp microneedling improves absorption.

relatedSections.title: The rationale behind research protocols
relatedSections.text:
- Gradual approach: start with a low dose to assess tolerance, then adjust as necessary.
- Usual recommended dose: 2 mg per day, taken daily (7 days a week).
- Cycle the treatment to manage copper load: ~4 weeks of treatment followed by ~4 weeks’ break.
- Routes of administration described: subcutaneous, intradermal or topical, depending on the formulation.
- Regularity and consistency are key: regeneration is a gradual process.
